author: Mark Atwood
text: Security review addition: test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json metadata (description line 3, lichen_native_sha512 profile text line 6, divergence note line 8) still presents the rejected SHA-512 profile as a live LICHEN profile and cites 'spec/06-security.md §8.5' as its source — a section that now states the profile is rejected and MUST NOT be used. When quarantining, also fix the file's description/profiles/divergence_note metadata and source citations; keep the upstream_addr_for_key vector byte-exact.
